WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        dateDiff('month', max(DateKey), toDate('2009-12-31')) AS months_since_last_purchase,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
        countDistinct(ProductKey) AS product_variety
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT
    multiIf(
        months_since_last_purchase <= 6, 'Active',
        months_since_last_purchase <= 12, 'At Risk',
        'Churned'
    ) AS recency_segment,
    avg(total_spend) AS average_spend,
    avg(product_variety) AS average_product_variety
FROM customer_metrics
GROUP BY recency_segment
ORDER BY
    multiIf(
        recency_segment = 'Active', 1,
        recency_segment = 'At Risk', 2,
        3
    )
